How to Navigate Dates

  • Swipe left to move to the previous day
  • Swipe right to move to the next day
  • Swipe up to move to the next month, but the same day of the month
  • Swipe down to move to the previous month, but the same day of the month

You can also 'click' on the secular date to see a date selection dialog box.
